subject: Emotions
title: Negotiation and Emotions
description: Learn Negotiation and Emotions in one minute.

hook.text: Two negotiators sit across the table. The one who reads emotions better walks away with the bigger share.

buildup.text: Chris Voss, former FBI hostage negotiator, says emotional intelligence is the most critical negotiation skill.

discovery.text: His technique 'tactical empathy' means labeling the other person's emotions: 'It sounds like you're frustrated.'

twist.text: Rational arguments often backfire in negotiations. People decide with emotions, then justify with logic afterward.

climax.text: Voss found that saying 'no' feels safer than 'yes.' Framing questions to invite 'no' paradoxically builds trust.

punchline.text: The best negotiators don't argue. They empathize strategically.

quiz.question: What is Chris Voss's key negotiation technique?
